content.text: {"verdicts":[{"check":"quote_supports_claim","artifact":"internal_summary","target":"Evidence excerpts U002, U011, U013, U017, U018, U019, U020","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"Each excerpt appears word for word in its cited line and supports the point it is attached to.","utterance_ids":["U002","U011","U013","U017","U018","U019","U020"]},{"check":"commitment_overstated","artifact":"internal_summary","target":"Lena Fischer: build the comparison once volumes arrive, 'about a week after Tobias sends the volumes'; no fixed date was said","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"The summary keeps Lena's commitment conditional on the volumes and flags that no fixed date was given; Tobias's 'tomorrow' and Isaac's invite are also stated as said.","utterance_ids":["U015","U017","U018","U020","U022"]},{"check":"buying_signal_overstated","artifact":"internal_summary","target":"Rachel Kim said the store rollup is 'exactly the view'... her open question is cost.","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"The summary ties the enthusiasm to the view only and notes that cost remains open, with leadership risk and no economic buyer recorded.","utterance_ids":["U011","U013"]},{"check":"superseded_feature_as_current","artifact":"internal_summary","target":"Point of sale and open orders merged into one model with a 5 minute refresh (RC-10)","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"The 5 minute refresh matches RC-10 and U004, and no superseded behavior is presented as current.","utterance_ids":["U004"]},{"check":"generic_step","artifact":"internal_summary","target":"Who approves a second platform: not named; Rachel to be asked (Isaac Morgan)","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"The open items are tied to Kestrel's workload, the missing signer, and Lena's dependency on volumes, and none is a generic check-in.","utterance_ids":["U013","U014","U015","U019"]}]}
